mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: At DDOSoft, we believe that powerful software shouldn't come at the expense of our planet. We provide expert consulting and development services to help organizations transform their technology infrastructure while significantly reducing energy consumption and environmental impact.

vision.title: Our Approach
vision.text: With 15+ years of proven experience in software architecture, cloud systems, and digital transformation, we deliver comprehensive solutions spanning from legacy system modernization to cutting-edge sustainable software development. Our expertise includes OCPP protocol implementation for EV charging systems, AWS cloud infrastructure optimization, embedded systems development, and enterprise-grade system integration.

ddogreen.name: DDOGreen
ddogreen.tagline: Smart Power Management That Just Works
ddogreen.intro: DDOGreen is an intelligent, production-ready power management tool that automatically switches your laptop between high-performance and power-saving modes based on actual system usage.
ddogreen.highlight: Automatic power mode switching driven by real CPU load, with hysteresis that prevents mode flapping

card.excerpt: Watches how busy your machine is and switches power modes automatically — install it and it works silently in the background, no setup needed.

items.title: Automatic Power Management:
items.description: Intelligent switching based on CPU load monitoring

items.title: Cross-Platform Support:
items.description: Native Linux (TLP) and Windows (Power Plans) integration

items.title: Zero Configuration:
items.description: Ships with a working default configuration — install it and it runs

items.title: Enterprise Ready:
items.description: Full systemd and Windows Service Manager integration

items.title: Production Quality:
items.description: Comprehensive unit test suite and CI/CD validation on every change

architecture.title: Technical Architecture
features: Smart hysteresis behavior (70% high performance, 30% power save)
Real-time CPU load monitoring with platform optimizations
Memory-efficient design with minimal system impact

tefaster.name: Tefaster
tefaster.tagline: Professional Portfolio Management for Turkish Mutual Funds
tefaster.intro: Tefaster is a production-ready Django application designed for managing Turkish mutual fund portfolios with daily TEFAS data integration. Built with modern web technologies and enterprise-grade practices, Tefaster provides a comprehensive solution for tracking investments, analyzing fund performance, and making informed portfolio decisions.
tefaster.highlight: Manage 2,316+ Turkish mutual funds with daily automatic updates and intelligent analytics

card.excerpt: Analyze and track all Turkish investment funds in one place. Prices update daily from TEFAS automatically. Free to start, no credit card required.

items.title: Multi-User Portfolio Management:
items.description: Secure, isolated portfolio tracking for multiple users with authentication and authorization

items.title: Daily TEFAS Integration:
items.description: Automatic daily updates for 2,316+ Turkish mutual funds with current pricing

items.title: Transaction Tracking:
items.description: Comprehensive buy/sell transaction management with automatic holding calculations

items.title: Fund Tagging System:
items.description: Flexible categorization with tag groups for organizing and filtering funds

items.title: Smart Price Fallback:
items.description: Automatic weekend/holiday price handling for accurate transaction valuation

items.title: Performance Analytics:
items.description: Interactive charts and metrics for portfolio performance tracking

architecture.title: Technical Excellence
features: Comprehensive automated test suite run in CI on every change
Enterprise security with bot protection and rate limiting
Database optimization with N+1 query prevention (83% reduction)
Pre-commit hooks with Ruff linting and Black formatting
Production-ready Docker setup with health checks
Background task processing with Celery for automatic updates
